chapter.verse: Pasian' mai-ah ahi zongin, mi a hingte leh a site' thu a khen ding ahi Khris Jesu' mai-ah ahi zongin, ama' hong kilatkik ding thu hangin leh ama' kumpigam tungtawnin ahi zongin, nang' tungah khauhtak kong genin ah:
Pasian' thu tangko in; hunte a lem-a a lem kei zongin kigingsa-in om in; lungduaina takpi leh hilhcianna tawh kopin a khialte a khialhna laktelin, taai-in, thapia in.
A hang pen mite in amau' cilesa lunggulhna huhau-in thuhilhna kilekkim ngai nuamlo-in amau' zaknop thuthakte a gen dingin a kiim uhah hilhcian syate a khop hun uh hong tung ding hi.
Thumaan thutak ngaihna pan pialkhia ding uh a, khanglui tuanthute lamah kiheikhia ding uh hi.
Nang na hihleh na khempeuh ah lungsim tei sinsenin gimsiatna thuak zo-in Lungdamna Thuhilh sya sem inla, na seppina tawntun in.
A hang pen lengtui biakpiakna bangin kei hong kisungkhia hita a, leitung ka nusiat ding hun hong nai ta hi.
Kidemna ah hoihtak ka pang khin hi. Taina lampi a mong dong ka tun hi. Upna ka kemcing khin hi.

Topa, a thutang Thukhen Mangpa, in tua Ni ciangin dikna lukhu hong guan ding a, tu-a kipan kei' ading kituamkoih ta hi. Kei bek hong guan ding hilo-in ama' hong kilat ding a lamlawp khempeuh zong guan ding hi.
Kei' kiang nong pai baih theih ding hihtheihtawp hong hanciam in.
A hang pen Demas in tulai khanghun a lunggulh manin kei hong nusia-in Thessalonica khua pai khinta hi. Crescens, Galatia gamke ah pai-in Titus, Dalmatia gamke ah pai hi.
Luke bek kei' kiangah om hi. Seppina sungah Mark phattuampih ka hih manin amah hong zawn inla hong tonpih in.
Tychicus ahihleh Ephesus khua ka paisak khin hi.
Nong pai ciangin Troas khua Carpus' kianga ka nusiat ka puantual leh laihualte, a diakdiakin savun laidalte, hong keng in.
Sumsanseek Alexander in kei' tungah thusia tampi hong bawl hi. Ama' gamtatte tawh kizui-in Topa in amah thukkik ding hi.
I thugente khauhtak hong nial ahih manin nangmahmah zong ama' kiangpan na kikepsiam in.
Mawhloh lahtelna thu ka gen masak lai-in kei hong dinpih kuamah om lo-in mi khempeuh in hong taisan hi. Tua tawh mawhsakna tuak kei ta uh hen.

Himah taleh Pasian' thu tangkona a kizawhsiang nading leh Gentile mi khempeuh in tua thu a zakkhak nadingin Topa in kei hong dinpihin hong thahatsak hi. Tua hangin humpi kamvang pan hotkhiatna ka ngah hi.
Topa in thusia namkim pan kei hong honkhia ding a, ama' vantung kumpigam sungah bittak hong tunpih ding hi. Tua Topa in a tawntung a tawntungin minpha ngah ta hen. Amen.
Prisca leh Aquila hitaleh Onesiphorus-te innkuan hitaleh na hopihsak in.
Erastus, Corinth khua ah omlai a, Trophimus a cina-in Miletus khua ah ka nusia hi.
Phalbi ma nong tun nadingin hihtheihtawp hong hanciam in. Eubulus, Pudens, Linus, Claudia leh sanggamte khempeuh in nang hong hopih uh hi.
Topa in nangma' kha hong ompih ta hen. Note' tungah hehpihna hong om ta hen.
